chunks.arabic_text: «إِنَّ ذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ لَمَّا انْتَهَى إِلَى السَّدِّ جَاوَزَهُ فَدَخَلَ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِمَلَكٍ قَائِمٍ عَلَى جَبَلٍ طُولُهُ خَمْسُمِائَةِ ذِرَاعٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْمَلَكُ يَا ذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ أَمَا كَانَ خَلْفَكَ مَسْلَكٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ ذُو الْقَرْنَيْنِ مَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ أَنَا مَلَكٌ مِنْ مَلَائِكَةِ الرَّحْمَنِ مُوَكَّلٌ بِهَذَا الْجَبَلِ وَلَيْسَ مِنْ جَبَلٍ خَلَقَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا وَلَهُ عِرْقٌ مُتَّصِلٌ بِهَذَا الْجَبَلِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَنْ يُزَلْزِلَ مَدِينَةً أَوْحَى إِلَيَّ فَزَلْزَلْتُهَا.»

translations.en: "Indeed, when Dhu al-Qarnayn reached the barrier, he passed beyond it and entered into the darkness. Then suddenly he was before an angel standing upon a mountain whose height was five hundred cubits. The angel said to him, 'O Dhu al-Qarnayn, was there not a path behind you?' Dhu al-Qarnayn said to him, 'Who are you?' He said, 'I am an angel from the angels of al-Rahman, entrusted with this mountain. There is no mountain that Allah has created except that it has a vein connected to this mountain. So when Allah, Mighty and Majestic, intends to cause a city to quake, He reveals to me, and I cause it to quake.'"

en.summary: This hadith relates a narrative about Dhu al-Qarnayn passing beyond the barrier and encountering an angel assigned to a great mountain. It presents a cosmological description in which earthly mountains are connected to a central mountain, and earthquakes occur by Allah’s command through the agency of an angel.
en.seo_question: What does the hadith say about Dhu al-Qarnayn, the darkness, and the cause of earthquakes?

key_terms.ذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ: Dhu al-Qarnayn, the figure spoken of in the narration
key_terms.السَّدِّ: the barrier or wall reached by Dhu al-Qarnayn
key_terms.الظُّلُمَاتِ: the darkness into which he entered
key_terms.مَلَكٍ: an angel encountered in that place
key_terms.الرَّحْمَنِ: the Most Merciful, referring to Allah
key_terms.عِرْقٌ: a vein or connecting root linking mountains
key_terms.يُزَلْزِلَ: to cause to quake or shake
key_terms.مَدِينَةً: a city afflicted by the earthquake
